name: shared-forwarder-covers-chords
description:
Cmd+Opt+I and Cmd+comma both arrive on the DEFAULT HTML surface, where they were dead.

Each chord is claimed in prePerformKeyEquivalent. The shared cause is fixed underneath - ChromeSurfaceKeyForwarder gives every CreateChromeContents surface a WebContentsDelegate, so an unhandled key comes back as a redispatch and postPerformKeyEquivalent is reachable again. This scenario is the measurement that says whether the per-chord claims are still load-bearing, and it is the regression guard for any that get removed: with a claim gone, the only thing left carrying that chord is the forwarder.

Anchored so a wrong window cannot pass. UpdateDockedDevtoolsForPane is the sole writer of the docked= line, and the fixture starts one browser window, so docked=1 names that window's pane. 'settings window built' and 'settings surface ready' are written only by the settings window, and the second only once the /settings module ran and answered over chrome.send - an empty or failed window does not reach it. The window count is the third leg: with both chords through, 2 is browser + settings, so DevTools is DOCKED. A detached DevTools would make it 3, and a dead Cmd+comma would make it 1.

actions.note: let the space and its single tab render
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot; without this the keystrokes land in Finder
one window, no DevTools, no settings
MEASUREMENT 1: DevTools on the visible tab
the DevTools frontend is a full WebContents load; the dock VLOG only fires once UpdateDockedDevtoolsForPane runs with a non-null GetInTabWebContents
let the window build and its route load
evidence of both surfaces at once

assertions.label: devtools-docked
assertions.note: Cmd+Opt+I reached the browser and DevTools resolved into the pane - the sole writer of this state

assertions.label: settings-window-built
assertions.note: Cmd+comma reached the settings window host

assertions.label: settings-route-loaded
assertions.note: settingsReady only arrives when the /settings module ran and chrome.send reached the host, so an empty shell cannot pass this
browser + settings. 1 means Cmd+comma did nothing; 3 means DevTools opened DETACHED rather than docked
